extracted.name: Vegetarian Pumpkin Chili
extracted.description: Combining easy canned ingredients with a few fresh components, this vegetarian pumpkin chili is an easy and convenient one pan meal that will warm you up during colder months. Feel free to make substitutions based on what you enjoy.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup chopped yellow onion (1/2 of a large onion)
1 small jalapeño, minced (remove seeds and ribs)*
3 (14 ounce) cans petite diced tomatoes, do not drain
1 (15 ounce) can pinto beans, drained and rinsed*
1 (15 ounce) can kidney beans, drained and rinsed*
1 large sweet potato, peeled and diced (about 1 heaping cup)*
optional: 1/2 (15 ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed*
instruction_lines: Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a 5 quart (or larger) pot or dutch oven. Add the onion, bell peppers, and jalapeño. Stir and cook for 5 minutes as the onion softens. Add garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, chili powder, and onion powder. Stir and cook for 1 minute. Add the remaining ingredients including black beans, if using.
Place the lid on top, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with any optional toppings. I strongly suggest cilantro for a little fresh kick. Yum!
